messages:
Marta: Quick heads up — partner call with AurumCloud about Aurora-west1 expansion in 30m. We need to lock quotas, marketplace cert window, KMS/HSM gating, and SI test matrix. Can folks confirm availability?
Samir: I can own the quota ticket. What SKUs and initial capacity numbers are they asking for?
Marta: Aurum asked for H100-80 x4 primary + A100-40 x6 as fallback, plus 2x spot pools. Initial sustained QPS estimate ~120 r/s for their beta.
Kevin: They're pushing for H100 hotpaths. Also marketplace entitlements must include both Hosted API and Dedicated SKU options. Legal flagged data residency + press language.
Olivia: I'll coordinate the marketplace listing timeline. What's our cert cutoff to make the joint announcement slot?
Marta: Certs need to be completed in 10 business days for marketing to hit the press date. If certs slip past that window we push announcement.
Samir: I'll open the quota ticket now — putting request payload in the ticket. Copying here for visibility:
```
region: aurora-west1
skus: [H100-80:4, A100-40:6, spot-fallback:2]
start_date: 2026-04-20
duration_estimate: 90 days
reason: AurumCloud joint launch beta — marketplace and dedicated capacity
contact: samir@redwood.com
```
Kevin: KMS: partner requested BYOK/HSM for private VPC customers. Ops needs to confirm KMS handoff doc and support matrix.
Ryan: SI integration note: we'll need to run the SI test matrix against the H100 runtime with our patched kernels. Network egress rules and cert pinning are common failure points. I'll draft the matrix after the call and link it here.
deploybot: preflight scheduled: 1764309900 — infra smoke tests will run for aurora-west1 nodes.
Olivia: Marketplace ask: confirm billing mapping (SKU codes + rev-share). Partner finance to confirm SKU codes; I'll loop them in.
Samir: Quota ticket CT-4521 created: https://cc.cloud/tickets/CT-4521 — assigned to cloud-quotas. Added HSM note.
Marta: Perfect — action items: 1) Samir: follow CT-4521 and escalate if quota ETA > 3bd, 2) Olivia: marketplace listing & billing mapping, 3) Ryan: SI test matrix + runbook, 4) Kevin: KMS/HSM handshake doc.
Olivia: Acknowledged :thumbsup: I'll ping partner-finance and legal after this thread.
aurum-bot: Partner onboarding checklist updated: docs/aurum/aurora-west1-onboard.md (CI artifacts pending).
Marta: Thanks all — can we meet 15m before the partner call to align on talking points? I'll drop a calendar invite.
Samir: 15m works for me.
Kevin: ack.
Ryan: ack — will bring the preliminary SI matrix draft.
Marta: Closing loop here after the prep meeting: follow-ups are CT-4521, marketplace PR #789, SI test matrix doc. I'll update this thread with any blockers.
Olivia: Ty!
